name: task-workflow
description: Set up project guidance, understand tasks, preserve working context, coordinate agents, verify deliverables, and keep a personal knowledge base whose cases the agent turns into rules, with a weekly review report.

interface.longDescription: Ten skills for setting up project instructions, understanding tasks and data, maintaining work notes, coordinating agents, verifying results, connecting a personal knowledge base, recording user context, letting the agent revise rules from recorded cases, running the daily upkeep sequence, and writing a weekly review report.
